meta.title: Sci Sideband
meta.description: Adds a research-exploration sideband to DeepSeek Harness. Give one research interest and objective; no topics are required. The sideband discovers relevant papers and content from arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Europe PMC, DOAJ, and Semantic Scholar, adds them as content, analyzes them in the background, captures traceable evidence (metrics, claims, conditions, verbatim quotes), then turns that evidence into actionable experiment suggestions and a coherent review article. Open it from the Sci Sideband icon in the left sidebar. It discovers, manages, explores, and synthesizes content; it does not run experiments or process raw experimental data. Open-access records may include full text; paywalled journals contribute metadata/abstract only, and full text depends on availability. Analysis uses the chat model configured under Settings → Models; without one it labels the result and falls back to local rules/templates. Data is stored locally in the sci-sideband folder under the DSH data directory; URLs are fetched through the web service and source text is sent to the selected model. Disabling the plugin removes the sideband and keeps saved data.
